people.name: Abiathar
people.line: High priest during the reigns of David and Solomon

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: David knew that Saul was devising mischief against him; and he said to Abiathar the priest, “Bring the ephod here.”
translations.bsb: When David learned that Saul was plotting evil against him, he said to Abiathar the priest, “Bring the ephod.”
translations.kjv: And David knew that Saul secretly practised mischief against him; and he said to Abiathar the priest, Bring hither the ephod.
translations.asv: And David knew that Saul was devising mischief against him; and he said to Abiathar the priest, Bring hither the ephod.
